text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
It was the first time I'd seen Festa<n>run since she
graduated. She used to<n>take my father's running
lessons for<n>Umamusume, so I thought I knew<n>what
she was like on the track.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
I could hardly believe what I was<n>seeing, but at the
same time, she was<n>still up to her same old
antics—even<n>as a new Tracen student.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
You see, a wildly famous<n>Umamusume was visiting
from<n>France, and somehow Festa got into<n>a
one-on-one race with her.
choice_data_list: She did?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
From what I heard, the French<n>Umamusume didn't
really consider<n>Festa an opponent. The freestyle
course's grass reminded her of<n>home, so she only
issued the<n>challenge for a chance to run.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
But none of the freestyle racers<n>milling about
wanted to accept a<n>challenge they'd surely lose.
This<n>was a high-level racing star, after all.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, her physique and skills<n>were a cut above.
If the street racers<n>were to contest that in good
faith, all it<n>would do is crush their confidence.<n>And
yet...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hah. Hahaha! Go ahead, get all<n>complacent. I'll
make you... regret it!

text_block_list.name: French Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah! ...Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Festa made her opponent take her<n>seriously. A
racer so obscenely<n>experienced compared to
herself. And<n>Festa just egged her on with that
gleam in her eyes... and the biggest<n>smile.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhgh, shut up! Shut up, shut UP! I<n>can't hear
anything over how loud<n>my heart's pounding!
Haha, I feel<n>so...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So alive!
choice_data_list: (A...live?)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Festa lost in the end, but she had her<n>claws around
the world's neck, if<n>only for an instant. She ran
herself<n>ragged, then collapsed right past the<n>finish
line.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
I imagine she'd been held up by<n>adrenaline alone,
so the fatigue<n>caught up all at once. But she did it. A
pre-debut street racer, up against a<n>world-class
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text: Cough, cough!
choice_data_list: Are you okay?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, sorry... I got a little too excitedthere. Cough... cough... Haaah...Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Please give her a place<n>where she feels
alive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
When she was younger, she was<n>always darting
into alleys, getting<n>herself into danger. She and her
troublemaker friends would take all<n>kinds of risks,
just for the cheap thrill<n>of it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
But the adrenaline high from those<n>games never
lasted long. Deep down,<n>what she really longs for
is...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama's Mentor
text_block_list.text:
Races—competitions where she can<n>let her instincts
run wild. I believe<n>that's the only place where
she'll<n>truly be able to set her heart free.
choice_data_list:
She just needs... somewhere to set her instincts
free...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I head home, I keep thinking about<n>the video I
just saw. Nakayama<n>Festa's running was
completely<n>different from what I saw at the<n>tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And I finally understand what the<n>difference is.
Everything comes down<n>to whether the stakes get
her fired up<n>or not.
choice_data_list:
(She needs something motivating like the race in
the video.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The opponent was leagues above her<n>in skill. Ten
out of ten people<n>would've called the odds
impossible... But that's what she<n>likes—the "what
if."
choice_data_list:
The tiny, crazy chance of winning big is what gets
her going.

The tiny, crazy chance of winning big is what gets
her going.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
So if we can find a way to up the ante<n>of her races...
maybe she'll have that<n>outlet she's been
craving—a place<n>where she feels alive.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Then, another thought sinks in like a<n>gulp of saliva
down a dry throat. I try<n>to force it through, but... it's
just a<n>wild fantasy. It's unrealistic, and I<n>have no
proof it could work.
choice_data_list:
But what if... what if I could give Nakayama the
motivation?

But what if... what if I could give Nakayama the
motivation?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's got the potential to take on the<n>world. If I can
draw out the sleeping<n>talent none of the instructors
could,<n>then I might really train up a global<n>star!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That evening, I get permission from<n>Miho Dorm's
leader to stake out the<n>entryway in hopes of
catching<n>Nakayama Festa.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait, are you—
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I've been wanting to speak with you. Figured
I could find you here.

Yeah. I've been wanting to speak with you. Figured
I could find you here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I explain that I'm the one she saved<n>at the pier, and
with a motion at my<n>trainer badge, I let her know
that I<n>saw her performance at the tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, that'd explain why the stranger<n>staking out
the dorm looked familiar.<n>So what's your deal?
Here to give<n>me your lofty trainer opinion on why I
should take my running more<n>seriously?
choice_data_list:
Actually, I happened to see a video of you running
pretty seriously against a French racer.

Actually, I happened to see a video of you running
pretty seriously against a French racer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: That's! ...So you met Teach, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That race was a one-time thing. Just<n>a lucky fluke.
And if you paid attention<n>at the tryouts, you'd know
it. I don't<n>have another race like that in me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
At the rate I'm going, I might bomb all<n>my debut
chances and get the boot<n>without a single win. All
'cause I'm<n>actin' like a brat who's too cool to<n>care
about newbie races.
choice_data_list:
About that—I've got a way to make races worth
your while.

About that—I've got a way to make races worth
your while.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: Let's pick a fight with the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If she's looking for risks and thrills,<n>then I've just
got to add challenges<n>to her races—and make sure
she<n>can't back out.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Win big or lose big. Earn everyone's<n>praise or deal
with their contempt.<n>That's all a competition really
needs<n>to come down to.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Nakayama Festa<n>and I sneak into
a press conference<n>where they're interviewing El
Condor<n>Pasa, a member of the "Golden<n>Generation"
of racers.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa seized the glory of<n>second place at
the world-renowned<n>Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, and
has<n>been taking an extended break since.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Yep. I spent some time looking for a<n>runner I could
pass the mask on to...<n>but y'know what? I'm not
throwin'<n>in the towel yet! I'm gonna get back<n>out
there and prove I'm the world's<n>strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And to do that, I've been cookin' up<n>plans for a
looong tour! If all goes<n>well, I can get the ball rolling
as early<n>as next yea—
choice_data_list: Not if we beat you and take the title first.
Not if we beat you and take the title first.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uh, rude. Right now, we're discussing<n>the future of
the world's strongest<n>Umamusume. You just
jumped into<n>the ring and challenged the champ.<n>You
know what that means, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It means that I'm gonna beat<n>you and take
those world tour plans<n>for myself, El.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You already had your match with the<n>global stars,
and you lost. But I've<n>got the potential to ride the
new tour<n>to the top.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm?
choice_data_list: We're willing to bet our future on it.
We're willing to bet our future on it.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You want me to challenge El? Theone who placed in the Arc? And youwant my pre-debut ass to do it infront of all the reporters?
choice_data_list: Yep. I'll take you straight to the global big leagues.
Yep. I'll take you straight to the global big leagues.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If we shoot our mouths off, the<n>media's definitely
gonna gobble the<n>drama up. It's a debut race with a
world career on the line, where<n>neither runner can
afford to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If Nakayama pulls it off, she instantly<n>becomes a
global sensation. If she<n>fails, she's the laughing
stock of the<n>world. Either way, it'll affect how<n>she's
viewed for the rest of her<n>career.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha. The chance to score a cushy<n>career for free
would get anyone<n>excited. But odds are, El's just
gonna kick my ass and that's the<n>end of me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If I make a bad impression at my<n>debut race, it tells
everyone that I'm<n>not worth training. You know that
could be career-ending, right?
choice_data_list: So you're gonna chicken out and play things safe?
So you're gonna chicken out and play things safe?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ah! ...Haha, well played. I'm the one<n>that egged you
on at that chicken<n>race, huh? I've gotta take my
own<n>advice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Let's decide who deserves those<n>career plans, El.
If you're in, we'll<n>handle the rest on our end. I've
got a<n>real debut race to prep for once I beat<n>you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're callin' a match with mepractice for your debut?! I can'tbelieve you. You don't know whatit's really like to take on the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I can't let you get away with all that<n>smack talk, or
you'll have other<n>people underestimating overseas
races too. Now... Failure, humiliation,<n>or
despair—which'll it be?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand that's how we signed<n>ourselves up for the
gamble of a<n>lifetime.
